start.content: Rabbi, look! The tree You cursed yesterday... it's completely withered! From the roots up!

miracle.content: It makes you realize who we're really walking with. He didn't just teach us a lesson; He showed us He has authority over the very earth we stand on.

choices.text: What did He say about the mountain?

faith.content: "He said if we have faith and do not doubt, we could tell this mountain to throw itself into the sea. I'm starting to think He wasn't exaggerating."

judgment.content: The Master is entering Jerusalem to face the leaders. That tree is a mirror. It looks healthy from a distance, just like the Temple rituals, but there's no fruit for God there.

choices.text: What did He teach about faith?

closing.content: "Have faith in God," He told us. It sounds simple, but watching that tree turn to dust... it's a heavy kind of simple. "Truly I tell you, if you say to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea,' it will happen."
